foreigner.zh: 现在，将其与估计在意大利生活和工作超过5年的250万外国人进行对比。

foreigner.en: And then there are the countries which courted wealthy foreigners with citizenship or tax incentives on the condition that they invested in property.
foreigner.zh: 然后还有一些国家，它们通过提供公民身份或税收优惠来讨好富裕外国人，条件是他们要在当地投资房地产。

foreigner.en: In Malta, the tiny Mediterranean island where I used to live, citizenship was given to foreigners on the condition they bought property over a certain value, thereby reducing the housing supply for locals and pushing up prices.
foreigner.zh: 在马耳他，这个我曾经居住过的小型地中海岛国，外国人在购买超过一定价值的房产的条件下可以获得公民身份，从而减少了当地人的住房供应并推高了房价。

fold.en: But many of the towns and cities it had “brought into the fold” were resentful.
fold.zh: 但它“纳入版图”的许多城镇和城市都心怀怨恨。

fold.en: Stonehouse was presumed drowned, or even eaten by sharks, after his clothes were found neatly folded on a Miami beach.
fold.zh: 在迈阿密海滩上发现了 Stonehouse 整齐叠放的衣服后，人们推测他溺水身亡，甚至可能被鲨鱼吃掉了。

fold.en: And the good news is that AI is getting much more energy-efficient, with that Google study reporting that energy use for each query is now 3% of what it was a year ago, a 33-fold reduction.
fold.zh: 好消息是，AI 的能效正在变得更高，那项谷歌研究报告称，现在每次查询的能源消耗是去年的 3%，即减少了 33 倍。

formidable.en: And it would be in the Iberian Peninsula–in modern day Spain–that he would learn the skills that turned him into such a formidable military commander.
formidable.zh: 正是在伊比利亚半岛——也就是今天的西班牙——他学会了让他成长为一名令人生畏的军事统帅的各种技能。

fortune.en: It's easy to ignore your gut fear when you're making a fortune in commissions.
fortune.zh: 当你通过赚取巨额佣金发家致富时，很容易忽视内心深处的恐惧。

fortune.en: The DeVos fortune comes from Amway. When I was a little girl, I wasn't exactly sure what Amway did.
fortune.zh: DeVos家族的财富来自Amway。当我还是个小女孩的时候，我其实并不清楚Amway是做什么的。

fortune.en: Some oligarchs, like Roman Abramovich, struck deals with Putin, pledging their loyalty in exchange for keeping their fortunes.
fortune.zh: 一些寡头，比如罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇，与普京达成了协议，宣誓效忠以换取保留他们的财富。

fortune.en: He arrived in Rabat as a disgraced former leader, his entourage vastly reduced, his fortune frozen or looted.
fortune.zh: 他以一个失势的前领导人身份抵达拉巴特，随行人员寥寥无几，财富被冻结或遭洗劫。

fortune.en: Exploration was the ultimate frontier, and it promised fortune, glory, and the chance to write your name into history.
fortune.zh: 探索是终极的前沿，它承诺带来财富、荣耀，以及将你的名字写入历史的机会。

fortunate.en: I was fortunate because maybe I had a bit more time, personal time to study than my other classmates.
fortunate.zh: 我很幸运，因为比起其他同学，我可能有更多的个人时间用来学习。

fortunate.en: Others, like Mikhail Khodorkovsky, were less fortunate.
fortunate.zh: 另一些人，比如米哈伊尔·霍多尔夫斯基，则没有那么幸运。

fortunate.en: I mean, I think, you know, one of the really early blessings, and I'll be honest, like this is where I think I was fortunate, right?
fortunate.zh: 我的意思是，我认为，你知道，这是非常早期的福分之一，老实说，我认为我在这方面很幸运，对吧？

fortunate.en: So many. When they're in it. And that's why I say, I think I was fortunate that I hit a really tough goal because my dad is a successful man relatively early on.
fortunate.zh: 太多了。当他们身处其中时。这就是为什么我说，我觉得我很幸运，因为我设定了一个非常艰难的目标，毕竟我父亲是个成功人士，而且我相对较早地实现了它。

forge.en: These elements were created during supernova explosions and collisions of neutron stars—cosmic events that forge the universe’s heaviest and most valuable materials.
forge.zh: 这些元素是在超新星爆炸和中子星碰撞过程中产生的——这些宇宙事件锻造出了宇宙中最重、最有价值的物质。

forge.en: But, fortunately, the craft had been forged from incredibly strong steel, and the men successfully went to the depths of the Mariana trench and returned alive and well.
forge.zh: 但幸运的是，这艘飞船是用极其坚固的钢材锻造的，这两个人成功地潜入了马里亚纳海沟的深处，并活着健康地返回了。

forge.en: But, the idea that Smith saw self-interest--which I think we think of usually as grasping, or as how I come down when I'm faced with a choice, say in a negotiation whether to leave money on the table or not, should I put myself first, and so on--there's such a broader view of that self-interest that you capture that is about our desire to remake the world in our own image, to forge it, to craft it, and your view that that's really what growth is about.
forge.zh: 但斯密所理解的自利——我们通常把自利理解为贪婪，或者理解为我在面临选择时会怎么做，比如在谈判中要不要把利益留一部分在桌面上，要不要把自己放在第一位，诸如此类——你所捕捉到的这种自利，其实有一个宽广得多的视角，它关乎我们想要按照自己的模样去重塑世界、去锻造它、去打磨它的欲望，而你的看法是，这才是经济增长真正的意义所在。

footstep.en: You know, I would know by the sounds of the footsteps whether or not my stepfather was sober or drunk.
footstep.zh: 你知道，我通过脚步声就能知道我的继父是清醒还是喝醉了。

footstep.en: Just as candidates on ‘The Apprentice’ competed to learn from Trump and follow in his footsteps, JD Vance is seen as the political apprentice set to continue the movement that Trump started.
footstep.zh: 正如《学徒》节目中的候选人竞争向Trump学习并追随他的脚步一样，JD Vance被视为将延续Trump所发起的政治运动的政治学徒。

footstep.en: Just by his footsteps, I knew. By the way he would close or open a door, I would know whether to be on edge or not. and so when i got that call everything in me let go like it was it was one of the most still is sort of like a painful memory you know is is like the first thought i had was damn it it happened i thought it would but not like this but it it it happened it happened yeah what is the cost you know because you described that spotty sense it almost sounds like a gift and the interesting thing to some degree it can be a gift yeah it is a gift i think every gift is a curse and i think every curse is a gift and what is the curse that comes with the gift so the curse that comes with it is i exist in a space where i am too aware of how other people feel you know and and as i've come to understand it what happens to a lot of children who are in abusive households is they develop their hypersensitivity as a tool to protect the parent because they start in the same way you were saying with your dad, why is he just sitting here?
footstep.zh: 仅仅通过他的脚步声，我就知道。通过他关门或开门的方式，我就知道是否要保持警惕。所以当我接到那个电话时，我内心的一切都崩溃了，就像它仍然是一种痛苦的记忆，你知道，第一个念头是：该死，它发生了。我以为会发生，但不是这样，但它发生了，它发生了。是的，代价是什么？因为你描述的那种蜘蛛感应听起来几乎是一种天赋，有趣的是，在某种程度上它确实可以是天赋。是的，它是一种天赋，我认为每种天赋都是一种诅咒，我认为每种诅咒都是一种天赋。那么伴随天赋而来的诅咒是什么？伴随它而来的诅咒是我存在于一个空间里，我对别人的感受太敏感了，你知道，正如我所理解的那样，很多处于虐待家庭的孩子会发展出这种高度敏感作为保护父母的工具，因为他们开始以你和你父亲的方式，为什么他只是坐在那里？

fortress.en: Rather than being one continuous wall, it’s probably better to think about the Great Wall as a network of different walls and watchtowers and fortresses and defensive barriers which stretch all across northern China.
fortress.zh: 与其说长城是一堵连绵不断的墙，不如把它想象成由各种城墙、瞭望塔、堡垒和防御工事组成的网络，绵延整个中国北方。

formulation.en: Together, they came up with a formulation for the skill they were talking about.
formulation.zh: 他们一起，为这种他们所讨论的能力，提出了一套阐述。

foresee.en: And, so, he foresaw exactly the phenomenon that you described, and that was really what the vision for Grameenphone was based on.
foresee.zh: 所以，他准确预见到了你刚才描述的这种现象，Grameenphone的整个构想正是建立在这个基础之上。

folk.en: And while the FBI and other law enforcement folks say they don't have the exact numbers, it's clear that fraud, like that fraud on Richard's application, was ubiquitous.
folk.zh: 虽然联邦调查局和其他执法人员表示他们没有确切的数字，但很明显，像理查德申请表上那样的欺诈行为可以说是无处不在。

folk.en: We followed a sample of the draft class of 2001, and so that’s about 10 years, and so we thought that would help us understand what happens to these folks.
folk.zh: 我们追踪了2001届选秀的样本，时间大约是10年，所以我们认为这能帮我们了解这些人后来遭遇了什么。

folk.en: So he still was part of the company. And, I said this, I was, like, 'It's incredible that you were able to achieve what you did in the environment that you did.' I mean, and both of them--both the Telenor folks and Iqbal--said, 'Well, actually in some ways it was easier.
folk.zh: 所以他当时还是公司的一员。我当时说：“你们能在那样的环境下取得这样的成就，真是不可思议。”结果他们俩——Telenor那边的人和伊克巴尔——都说：“其实从某些方面来说，反倒更容易一些。

fog.en: And maybe not brain fog, maybe just the clarity of my thoughts now is so much better than it used to be.
fog.zh: 也许不是脑雾，也许只是我现在思维的清晰度比过去好多了。

fog.en: Whenever I wanted to try and get myself back into the present, I used to have brain fog a lot in my twenties.
fog.zh: 每当我想让自己回到当下时，我二十多岁时经常有脑雾。

foster.en: The other guys in the band were Jeff Foster and Tim Fleming.
foster.zh: 乐队的其他成员是杰夫·福斯特（Jeff Foster）和蒂姆·弗莱明（Tim Fleming）。

foster.en: One of those forms? School choice means fostering a system of charter schools as alternatives to the regular public school system.
foster.zh: 其中一种形式是什么？择校意味着扶持一个特许学校系统，作为常规公立学校系统的替代方案。
